extracts.lead_summary: The breakout held. XLV rose 1.45% to $179.28 — a third straight weekly gain — with a closing high of $181.30 on Thursday, the best on the adjusted bars in two years. SPY fell 0.4%. The medtech-and-tools prints split: Intuitive beat (EPS $3.00 vs ~$2.65, procedures +15%) and rose 6.0% on the week; Danaher beat and raised; Thermo Fisher beat and slipped 2.3%; Abbott met on EPS, cut its sales guide to 6% and fell 1.1%. Elevance beat by a wide margin ($6.99 adjusted, about $1.85 of it non-operating) and raised to at least $29; it made a two-year closing high Thursday with CI, LLY and AMGN. Lilly closed at a two-year high Thursday and fell 2.5% Friday with no cause found. Biotech bounced: XBI +3.6%. Arcus fell 16% on a $250M offering at $17.50.
